# Project Overview

This repository contains serveral web servers for a photo portfolio.
They are generally Node JS applications which are deployed into AWS using Terraform and GitHub actions.

## Folder Structure

- `/frontend`: Contains the source code for the frontend which is publically accessible. It is the homepage of the service
- `/admin-frontend`: Contains the source code for an admin interface for managing the photo portfolio.
- `/docs`: Contains documentation for the project, including API specifications and user guides.
- `/terraform`: Contains Terraform scripts for deploying the application to AWS.

## Libraries and Frameworks

- React and Tailwind CSS for the frontend.
- Node.js and Express for the backend.
- MongoDB for data storage.

## Coding Standards

- Use semicolons at the end of each statement.
- Use single quotes for strings.
- Use function based components in React.
- Use arrow functions for callbacks.

## UI guidelines

- Application should have a modern and clean design.
